definitions: A device fitted to a boiler to preheat the feedwater using waste heat from the exhaust gases.
A device in a carburetor that enriches the fuel-air mixture at high engine speeds.
A system in an air conditioning unit that uses cool outside air to reduce the need for mechanical cooling.
examples: The boiler's economizer improved its efficiency.
He adjusted the economizer on the carburetor.
The building's HVAC system includes an economizer.
